summary.text: Bonnie Abadie is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 102 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Ana-Maria Ramos.
A small business owner, she says education reform is her top priority.

paragraphs.text: Abadie earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from Louisiana State University.
Her listed career experience is as a small business owner, managing North Dallas Martial Arts, Inc. and Paradise on Palestine, LLC.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Abadie said she has run for school board three times and that education is the policy area she is most passionate about.
She said her top priority is education reform, including repealing the voucher bill and eliminating state testing.
She also called for examining and auditing the state budget and for a review of government spending similar to the federal DOGE effort.
